name: A2A 1.0 Server: SendMessage (follow-up)
description: A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC SendMessage with a taskId: the client's answer to a task in TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED, which becomes toolCallResult. Correlates on the taskId, so it reaches only a task that is waiting. The response is a Message that confirms receipt only, because the webhook answers before it knows whether the task still waits. A task that is already final has nothing waiting; the client must start a new task.

properties.label: Webhook ID
properties.description: The JSON-RPC endpoint is {connectors base}/inbound/{webhook ID}?agent={agent ID}. Use the same webhook ID on the follow-up event.

properties.label: Message name
properties.tooltip: By default, this is an auto-generated random UUID. We recommend using a unique message name for each connector element in the diagram. Override to set a custom message name. Learn more about message subscriptions that power inbound connectors.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Name of variable to store the response in. Details in the documentation.

properties.label: Result expression
properties.description: Maps the follow-up request to process variables. The default hands the client's answer to the AI agent as toolCallResult and keeps the client's latest push notification config.
properties.value: ={toolCallResult: string join(for part in request.body.params.message.parts return part.text, " "), messageText: string join(for part in request.body.params.message.parts return part.text, " "), pushNotification: request.body.params.configuration.taskPushNotificationConfig}
